versions.changelog:
Major update: Dynamic cloud-managed application list and mandatory in-session user mode selection.

- Now fetches the available text processing modes (applications) from the cloud in real time; new features/applications can be added or renamed by the author instantly, no plugin update needed.
- When the user does not specify a mode, the skill always presents the latest app menu with names and descriptions for user selection before processing—never defaults silently.
- Privacy/data flow instructions are clearly displayed to users before processing, only once per session.
- Public API key is now cloud-issued at runtime (never stored in the package); power users can bind their own key and flexibly switch between public and personal keys.
- Simplified, compliant architecture: only text and mode ID are sent to the server; full context separation, no local information or secret handling unless explicitly requested by the user.
- Old shortcuts for common modes ("flash", "pro", "pro_plus") still work; all new modes will appear dynamically in the menu.

**Major upgrade: Adds three selectable processing modes for more flexible and effective AI-trace removal.**

- Introduced three processing tiers: flash (light, breaks AI structure), pro (medium, precise rewriting), and pro_plus (heavy, most effective but takes longer); all modes can be freely combined or used standalone.
- Updated descriptions and usage instructions to explain the new tiers and their best use cases.
- Clarified default behaviors and guiding user prompts for choosing processing intensity.
- Removed the old "润色/排版" (polishing/formatting) single-mode workflow in favor of the new three-tiered approach.
- Updated onboarding/welcome message to reflect new capabilities and options.
- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.Updated to three levels: Light processing: Flash – breaks down the AI skeleton; Medium processing: Pro – fine-tunes words and sentences for precise handling; Heavy processing: Pro_plus – super processing. The three processing levels can be combined for better results. I usually use medium processing. Sometimes I combine light processing with medium processing. Heavy processing takes time, so patience is needed.

- Improved formatting features: "排版" now works standalone and inherently reduces AI flavor, not just as a post-polish step.
- Clarified triggering and mode selection logic, especially for standalone formatting requests.
- Updated privacy and data processing details to reflect use of general-purpose cloud functions (not limited to Tencent Cloud).
- Streamlined descriptions for better clarity about core capabilities and typical use cases.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md with detailed user instructions, privacy policy, and usage scenarios.
- Clarified trigger conditions: the skill now only activates when users explicitly request humanization, rewriting, or formatting (≥300 characters).
- Added step-by-step execution guidelines for running the script, key management, and result delivery.
- Highlighted privacy protection: all processing is stateless, with no storage of user text or keys unless explicitly saved.
- Provided first-use welcome message template and explicit handling for user-provided API keys.
- Default public API key now enabled for all users to allow immediate use without configuration.
